title: Coherent restriction of relative right Kan extensions
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces and full subcategories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and relative limit diagrams and join cones of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Work in a fixed sufficiently large universe. Let $j:A\hookrightarrow C$ be a full subcategory of a small quasicategory, let $p:D\to B$ be an isofibration of quasicategories, and let $s:C\to B$ be a functor. Here an isofibration is an inner fibration as in [def-coef-infinity-fibrations] which lifts each equivalence to an equivalence with any prescribed source. Put $\operatorname{Fun}_s(C,D)=\operatorname{Fun}(C,D)\times_{\operatorname{Fun}(C,B)}\{s\}$, the degreewise fiber, and define $\operatorname{Fun}_{sj}(A,D)$ similarly. For $c\in C$ put $J_c=A\times_C C_{c/}$, using simplices starting at $c$ and their entire remaining face, and let $l_c:J_c^{\triangleleft}\to C$ be its canonical cone. A functor $H\in\operatorname{Fun}_s(C,D)$ is $p$-right Kan extended from $A$ when $Hl_c$ is a $p$-limit diagram for every $c$. Let $\mathcal K$ be the full subcategory of $\operatorname{Fun}_s(C,D)$ on these functors. Assume that every $h\in\operatorname{Fun}_{sj}(A,D)$ has such an extension $H$ with $Hj=h$ exactly. Then restriction $j^*:\mathcal K\to\operatorname{Fun}_{sj}(A,D)$ is a trivial Kan fibration of simplicial sets: it has the right lifting property for every boundary inclusion $\partial\Delta^r\hookrightarrow\Delta^r$, $r\geq0$. In particular restriction is an equivalence of infinity categories and induces natural equivalences of their mapping spaces. Thus extensions of diagrams, transformations and higher parameter simplices with any already prescribed compatible boundary exist coherently; no global completeness assumption on $D$ or on the fibers of $p$ is imposed.
